title: Speedboat leap and landing

source.why_this_clip: A speedboat with two riders bursts out from behind cypress trees, leaps into the air and lands on the lake, skidding with spray. The clip has no detected cuts; this interval starts when the boat first appears and runs to the last frame.

source_selection.evidence: Builder inspected sixteen raw source frames across the provisional event in preflight-source.jpg; no cut/dissolve observed inside retained interval. Normal-speed playback unrun.
